title: Localization of graded sections at an invertible-module section
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme] (the intersection of any two affine opens is quasi-compact), $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L)$, and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent] $\mathcal O_X$-module. Put $X_s=\{x\in X:s(x)\ne0\text{ in }\mathcal L_x\otimes\kappa(x)\}$ and $N=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbf Z}\Gamma(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$, where negative powers mean tensor powers of the dual invertible module. Multiplication by $s$ makes $N$ a graded module over $\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$. The canonical map from the degree-zero part $N_{(s)}$ of its localization at $s$ to $\Gamma(X_s,\mathcal F)$, sending $t/s^n$ ($t\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$, $n\ge0$) to $t|_{X_s}\otimes(s|_{X_s})^{-n}$, is an isomorphism.
